maddeler.e:
يرتقب (form VIII)
# يَرْتَقِبُ (yartaqibu) /jar.ta.qi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# يُرْتَقَبُ (yurtaqabu) /jur.ta.qa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# يَرْتَقِبَ (yartaqiba) /jar.ta.qi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# يُر
